C3.name: Special Events Permits
C3.description: Applications received and Special Event permits issued by Special Events Office, Office of Economic Development, since 2019

fields.name: Application Date
fields.description: Date application was received by SE Office

fields.name: Permit Status
fields.description: Status of permit (in process, issued, withdrawn, cancelled, etc)

fields.name: Permit Type
fields.description: Event type description (Special Event, Charter Vessel, Valet)

fields.name: Event Category
fields.description: Category (Community, Commercial, Athletic, Free Speech, etc)

fields.name: Event Sub-Category
fields.description: Athletic event type descriptor (Water, Cycling, Run/Walk)

fields.name: Name of Event
fields.description: Name of event as provided by applicant

fields.name: Year-Month-App#
fields.description: Permit number assigned by Special Events Office

fields.name: Event Start Date
fields.description: Event Start date

fields.name: Event End Date
fields.description: Event End date

fields.name: Event Location - Park
fields.description: Park location (if applicable)

fields.name: Event Location - Neighborhood
fields.description: Neighborhood location(s)

fields.name: Council District
fields.description: Council District location(s)

fields.name: Precinct
fields.description: SPD precinct location(s) or SPD office(s)

fields.name: Organization
fields.description: Organization on application

fields.name: Attendance
fields.description: Attendance as reported by applicant

C4.name: Active Business License Tax Certificate
C4.description: This dataset contains active business license tax certificate data for the City of Seattle
C4.attribution: Department of Finance and Administrative Services

fields.name: Business Legal Name
fields.description: Legal name of the business.

fields.name: Trade Name
fields.description: Doing Business As (DBA), also known as the trade name of the business.

fields.name: Ownership Type
fields.description: Type of business, such as sole proprietorship (SP), partnership (PT), or limited liability corporation (LLC).

fields.name: NAICS Code
fields.description: A code identifying the type of business. NAICS stands for North American Industry Classification System.

fields.name: NAICS Description
fields.description: Full description of North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code.

fields.name: License Start Date
fields.description: Date business was opened in Seattle.

fields.name: Street Address
fields.description: Physical (street) address at which the business is located.

fields.name: City
fields.description: City

fields.name: State
fields.description: State  in which the business is located.

fields.name: Zip
fields.description: ZIP code  in which the business is located.

fields.name: Business Phone
fields.description: Phone number provided by the business.

fields.name: City Account Number
fields.description: Unique license number issued by the City of Seattle.

fields.name: UBI
fields.description: Unified Business Identifier (UBI) number issued by the City of Seattle.

excluded: Cached sample values, owner account identifiers and unrelated metadata omitted; complete response hashes are in request-ledger.json.
